settings.name: --ip-idle-expiry-ms
settings.scope: IP datagram inactivity interval in capture-time milliseconds

settings.name: --ip-overlap
settings.scope: Policy for conflicting bytes in overlapping IPv4 or IPv6 fragments

settings.name: --max-bytes
settings.scope: Maximum aggregate captured payload bytes read from the input; a reader bound, unrelated to the live traffic budget of the same name

settings.name: --max-duration-ms
settings.scope: Maximum analysis run time in milliseconds

settings.name: --max-flows
settings.scope: Maximum capture-global distinct conversations per transport. Expiry does not release index entries; raising this increases retained metadata

settings.name: --max-frame-bytes
settings.scope: Maximum bytes accepted from any one captured frame or PCAPNG block

settings.name: --max-frames
settings.scope: Maximum physical input frames, including frames rejected by the filter

settings.name: --max-interfaces
settings.scope: Maximum PCAPNG interfaces accepted from the input

settings.name: --max-ip-bytes-per-datagram
settings.scope: Maximum fragmentable payload bytes accepted for one IP datagram

settings.name: --max-ip-datagrams
settings.scope: Maximum incomplete IPv4 and IPv6 datagrams retained concurrently

settings.name: --max-ip-fragments-per-datagram
settings.scope: Maximum physical fragments accepted for one retained IP datagram

settings.name: --max-ip-outcomes
settings.scope: Maximum per-datagram IP outcomes retained for aggregate reporting

settings.name: --max-ip-reassembly-bytes
settings.scope: Maximum retained IP, derived cascade, and metadata bytes

settings.name: --max-scope-bytes
settings.scope: Maximum charged capture-scope and encapsulation metadata bytes

settings.name: --max-tcp-bytes-per-flow
settings.scope: Maximum retained TCP stream bytes in one direction

settings.name: --max-tcp-reassembly-bytes
settings.scope: Maximum retained TCP payload and metadata bytes

settings.name: --max-tcp-segments-per-flow
settings.scope: Maximum pending out-of-order segments retained for one TCP direction

settings.name: --tcp-idle-expiry-ms
settings.scope: TCP flow inactivity interval in capture-time milliseconds
